name: Cabbage Casserole
description: A creamy cabbage casserole with a crunchy bread crumb topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook cabbage wedges until tender, then drain and cut into large pieces.
Make a white sauce with butter, flour, and milk. Season with salt, grated cheese, and Cheez Whiz.
Combine cooked cabbage with the white sauce mixture.
Top with crumbled buttered bread.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

keywords: cabbage casserole, creamy vegetable dish, comforting main course

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A classic broccoli casserole with a cheesy, soup-based sauce and a crunchy topping.
recipeIngredient: Butter and bread crumbs or fried onions for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Partially cook broccoli and drain. Place in a large casserole dish.
Mix together Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, and cooked rice. Pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with butter and bread crumbs or a can of fried onions before serving.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli casserole topped with a cheesy bread crumb mixture, perfect for a comforting vegetable side.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together broccoli, celery, and mushroom soup. Place in a casserole dish.
Make the topping by combining grated cheese, melted margarine, sour cream, and bread crumbs.
Spread the topping over the casserole.
Bake at 325 °F to 350 °F for 25 to 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy, comforting vegetable side

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Barley and Corn Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty barley casserole with corn, carrots, and garlic, perfect as a comforting side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy casserole. Cook onion, garlic, and carrots until the onion is softened, stirring frequently.
Stir in barley and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, cover, and bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.
Test that barley is tender. Stir in corn and parsley.
Return to the oven to heat through. Season with pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: barley casserole, corn, carrots, comforting side dish

_similar.name: Mock Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: A casserole-style dish mimicking cabbage rolls, featuring a savory ground beef and rice mixture layered over shredded cabbage and topped with cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown hamburger with chopped onion, salt, pepper, mushrooms, seasoning salt, onion powder, and garlic salt in a skillet.
Add rice, tomatoes, and soup to the browned hamburger mixture; mix well.
Shred cabbage and place in the bottom of a large casserole dish.
Place the hamburger mixture on top of the cabbage layer.
Cover and bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven, sprinkle cheddar cheese on top, cover, and return to oven for an additional 15 to 30 minutes, or until cabbage is cooked and cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: mock cabbage rolls, casserole, cheesy cabbage
